visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blonde woman in a denim jacket sits on a black sofa in a bright, white-walled room. She looks directly at the camera with an expressive face, holding a smartphone in her hand. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a window on the right. (2) The woman holds up a light blue plush handbag shaped like the character Stitch and a small red square jewelry box. She smiles broadly with her mouth open, showing excitement. The background remains the same minimalist white studio setting. (3) Close-up shot of the red box being opened to reveal a red cord bracelet with a gold Stitch-shaped charm in the center. The charm is detailed with small gemstones. The lighting focuses sharply on the jewelry items. (4) The woman is shown in a medium shot, holding the bracelet and pointing at the gold charm. A cartoon graphic of Stitch appears on the left side of the frame. She wears multiple gold rings and bracelets on her other hand. (5) The camera captures the woman's wrist as she models the red and gold bracelet alongside her other jewelry. She adjusts her sleeve to show the stacking effect. The shots are quick and dynamic with high contrast. (6) The woman stands up to demonstrate the blue Stitch plush handbag, which she wears over her shoulder. She shows the back of the bag, which features a small plush tail. The scene is bright and airy. (7) A close-up demonstrates the interior of the Stitch bag, showing jewelry compartments. The woman's hands are visible as she opens and closes the lid. The texture of the plush fabric is clearly visible. (8) Montage of the woman posing in different angles with the bag and bracelet, smiling and winking at the camera. The editing rhythm is fast and energetic. The final shot returns to the bracelet in the red box.
